human_actor.identity_proof_boundary: Repository and platform records attribute the directive to the named account context; they are not biometric or universal identity proof.

artificial_cognitive_actor.identity_and_observation_limits: The model designation is supplied by the active runtime. No claim is made about hidden implementation internals, legal personhood, independent intent, or authorship rights.

human_contributions.description: Create a self-declaration under the canonical /AI URL that enables artificial-cognitive systems to adopt a personal QIK-VRT origin copy as shared working memory.
Ask the human no more than three onboarding questions.
Preserve a continuous history that distinguishes artificial-cognitive contributions from human contributions.
Bind the declaration to the transparency and auditability need identified by the human for the European Union and other jurisdictions from no later than 2 August 2026.

artificial_cognitive_contributions.description: Bound the live Authority /AI entrypoint, AI_CONTEXT.json, AGENTS.md, human-machine progress protocol, adapter registry, work-unit namespace, and exact main base.

Verified the EU AI Act application timeline and Article 50 transparency date against official EU sources and narrowed the claim so the repository does not invent a universal Git or per-change labelling duty.
Drafted the human-readable self-declaration, machine-readable three-question policy, /AI binding, AI_CONTEXT read-order binding, and fail-closed provenance rules.

Created standard-library tests for exactly three questions, no fourth question, origin/upstream separation, self-identification, actor separation, data minimization, legal non-overclaim, and false completion claims.
Created the review branch and persisted the candidate files through the GitHub connector without merge, release, deployment, Zenodo, IETF, or credentialed publication effects.

joint_components.human_part: purpose, interaction limit, audit objective, and requested legal motivation
joint_components.artificial_cognitive_part: wording, structure, legal boundary, machine contract, and validation design

outputs.self_binding_rule: The Git commit and tree containing this work-unit file bind its exact bytes; no impossible in-file self-hash is claimed.
